sentences.en: This app automatically signs you in when you open it.
sentences.zh: 这个应用在你打开它的时候会自动登录。

sentences.en: Crises do not automatically produce the right recipes against them.
sentences.zh: 危机并不一定会带来正确的应对方法。

sentences.en: When you open the door, the light comes on automatically.
sentences.zh: 你一开门，灯就会自动亮起。

senses.zh: 自动地；机械地；无意识地

mnemonic: 词根记忆：auto（自己）+mat（=mob，动）+ical（…的）+ly（…地）→自动地
